original: WATER
translation: 饮水

original: Water is essential. Explore your surroundings until you find a source of fresh water like a lake or even a pond, then take a big gulp of fresh water and start out again with new strength. In the winter, it won't be so easy - you'll need to use your fishing skill to make a hole in the ice. If you're wondering what's in a certain location you can take a look and examine it if it's within your field of vision.
translation: 水是生存必需品。探索周围，找到湖泊或池塘等淡水水源，喝上一大口，恢复精力后继续上路。冬天就没那么容易了——你需要用捕鱼技能在冰上凿个洞。如果想知道某处有什么，只要它在视野范围内，就可以查看并仔细观察。

original: You can stay alive without food for weeks, but unless you have water you will die of dehydration in days.
translation: 即使没有食物，你也能活上数周；但没有水，几天内就会脱水而死。

original: Quaff (drink) something
translation: 喝点东西

original: Look what is at the chosen location
translation: 查看选定位置的情况

original: A CLOSER LOOK
translation: 仔细观察

original: You can zoom in and out between the large scale wilderness map and a smaller scale local terrain map. Now zoom in to a local map to explore the area you are in more closely. The zoomed in map reflects the wilderness location accurately, so if there's a lake to the north on the wilderness map, you can find it by traveling north on the zoomed in map as well. You may want to look in a given direction or investigate the location you are at more closely to see what's around you.
translation: 你可以在荒野地图和局部地形图之间缩放。现在切换到局部地图，更仔细地探索所在区域。局部地图会准确对应荒野地图上的位置：如果荒野地图上北边有湖，在局部地图上向北走也能找到它。你可以朝某个方向观察，或仔细查看当前位置，看看周围有什么。

original: You are now on a zoomed in local terrain map. Take some time to explore your surroundings a bit. In general, long distance travel is performed on the wilderness map, and encountering animals or people, living a settled daily life, fishing, trapping, gathering berries and such takes place on the zoomed in map.
translation: 你现在位于放大的局部地形图上。花些时间探索周围环境。通常，长途旅行是在荒野地图上进行；遭遇动物或人、过日常定居生活、捕鱼、设陷阱、采集浆果等活动，则是在放大的局部地图上进行。

original: Zoom in/out between wilderness and terrain map
translation: 在荒野地图与地形图之间缩放

original: Look what is at the current location
translation: 查看当前位置的情况

original: PICKING UP
translation: 拾取物品

original: On the zoomed in maps you can find items such as branches, fallen trees, stones etc. lying around. Depending on the season and the terrain type you may also find natural food like mushrooms and berries. All of this is picked up the same way. Now try and pick up something you find nearby on the ground. To see what you are already carrying check out your inventory.
translation: 在放大的地图上，你会看到散落的树枝、倒木、石头等物品。根据季节和地形，你也可能找到蘑菇、浆果等天然食物。拾取这些东西的方法都一样。现在试着捡起附近地上的某样东西。要查看已经携带的物品，请打开物品栏。

original: Alright, you've picked up something. Remember that carrying heavy loads slows down your physical skill activities, makes movement slower and combat more challenging.
translation: 很好，你已经捡起了东西。记住，负重过多会拖慢体力类技能活动和移动，也会让战斗更棘手。

original: Pick up from adjacent tile, pack animal o..
translation: 从相邻格子、驮畜或同伴处拾取

original: Inventory -- look at what you are carrying
translation: 查看随身物品

original: MAKE A FIRE
translation: 生火

original: To survive in the wilderness, especially in the winter, you need to learn how to make a fire. That's your next task. You can find and pick up several branches and drop them where you wish to build a fire, use your timbercraft skill to cut branches from a tree, or you can even set fire to a dry fallen tree. To place heavy trunks or a pile of firewood to a location where you wish to build a fire you can use the push items-command. Finally, use start a fire command to light up the firewood.
translation: 想在荒野中生存，尤其是在冬天，你得学会生火。这就是你的下一个任务。你可以拾取几根树枝，放到想生火的地方；也可以用伐木技能从树上砍下树枝，甚至点燃干燥的倒木。要把沉重的原木或一堆柴火移到生火地点，可以使用“推送/装载”命令。最后使用生火命令点燃柴火。

original: Fire keeps you warm during cold weather, and will burn as long as it has enough fuel. To feed the burning fire you need to occasionally move some wood, or other burnable items, into the fire.
translation: 天气寒冷时，火能让你保持温暖；只要燃料充足，火就会持续燃烧。要给火添柴，你需要不时把木头或其他可燃物移进火里。

original: Drop something
translation: 丢下物品

original: Push/pack -- push items at your feet to an adjacen..
translation: 推送/装载：移动脚边物品或装上驮兽

original: Skills -- view and use your skills
translation: 技能——查看和使用技能

original: Start a fire
translation: 生火

original: As you probably will need to fish and hunt for your livelihood, you also need to learn to cook what you catch or kill. Now use your cookery skill to prepare some food. The most simple recipe is just to roast raw fish or meat over the campfire. While the food is being cooked and if you don't have anything else to do, you can use the wait or rest commands to kill some time. Your nose will tell you when the food is ready so be ready to cancel your lazy time or you will burn the food.
translation: 你大概需要捕鱼和狩猎来维持生计，因此也得学会烹煮捕获或猎杀的食物。现在用烹饪技能准备食物。最简单的做法就是把生鱼或生肉放在营火上烤。烹煮期间，如果没别的事可做，可以使用等待或休息命令打发时间。食物烤好时会闻到香味，记得及时结束休息，否则食物会烤焦。

original: Raw meat and fish will spoil pretty quickly if not cooked. Recipes vary in nutrition as well as in preservation time. It's worthwhile to take some time to learn more about them at some point.
translation: 生肉和生鱼如果不烹煮，很快就会变质。不同食谱的营养价值和保存时间各不相同。找时间了解一下这些食谱很有帮助。

original: Wait and rest until cancelled
translation: 等待并休息，直到取消

original: TIMBERWORK
translation: 木材加工

original: Your task is to fell a tree - for which you need to zoom in to a local map. You'll need an axe to fell bigger trees but only a knife is required for slender trunks or small trees. Now check out your inventory, stand by the tree you wish to cut down and fell it by using your timbercraft skill. You can wield your chosen tool/weapon to get through the required equipment selection list faster.
translation: 你的任务是砍倒一棵树——这需要先切换到局部地图。砍大树需要斧头，砍细树干或小树则只要小刀。现在查看物品栏，站到想砍的树旁，用伐木技能将它砍倒。预先装备好选定的工具或武器，可以更快通过所需装备的选择列表。

original: The wood from trees in all its various forms is a very useful material which can be used for many different purposes. You can continue processing the tree you just felled with your timbercraft skill if you like. Notice that not every felled tree is suitable for every purpose. The main difference is whether the trunk is a slender one, from a young or small tree, or a big, fully grown one. When working with lumber, the type of axe used often has a major influence on the required working time and the quality of the result.
translation: 树木的木材有多种形态，是用途广泛的材料。你可以继续用伐木技能加工刚砍倒的树。注意，并非每棵砍倒的树都适合所有用途。主要区别在于树干是来自幼树或小树的细树干，还是来自完全长成的大树的粗树干。加工木料时，所用斧头的类型往往会显著影响耗时和成品质量。

original: Wield a weapon or tool
translation: 装备武器或工具

original: DO IT YOURSELF
translation: 自己动手

original: You can make various items by yourself; tools, weapons, clothes, even buildings. Go ahead and try to make yourself an item. You may want to check out your inventory first to see what you have and what you need - you might want to try an easy piece of woodwork as your first attempt.
translation: 你可以自己制作各种物品：工具、武器、衣物，甚至建筑。试着制作一件物品吧。可以先查看物品栏，看看自己有什么、还缺什么；第一次不妨试试简单的木工制品。

original: You can equip yourself pretty well with only self-made items. Sometimes, when you are unable to buy or trade for the equipment you need you will have to do with items you can make yourself. This can actually be very rewarding and great fun if you want to live the life of a hermit or wandering adventurer.
translation: 只靠自制物品，你也能把自己装备得相当齐全。有时你买不到或换不到所需装备，就只能使用自己能做的东西。如果你想过隐士或漂泊冒险者的生活，这其实很有成就感，也很有趣。

original: Make items and constructions
translation: 制作物品和建筑

original: Next you need to try out fishing, a good and relatively easy way to keep yourself fed. You can fish with a fishing rod, a spear or even a club. These are active fishing methods. You can fish passively by using nets. Now find a suitable body of water, like a lake or river, and use your fishing skill. Before going fishing you may want to eat some food if you have any as it's more comfortable to wait for a catch on a full stomach.
translation: 接下来试试捕鱼，这是维持生计的一种好方法，而且相对容易。你可以用鱼竿、鱼叉甚至木棒捕鱼，这些都属于主动捕鱼；也可以用渔网被动捕鱼。现在找一片合适的水域，比如湖泊或河流，然后使用捕鱼技能。出发捕鱼前，如果有食物，不妨先吃一点；吃饱后等待鱼儿上钩会舒服些。

original: There are many factors that define how many and what kind of fish you'll catch - if you do catch anything. The fishing method and equipment used and your fishing skill do affect your luck of course. Different types of fish are found at different depths of water and some only live in lakes and others in rivers. Your chances of catching certain fish will also depend on the time of the day. These are things you'll learn as you gain experience with various equipment and tactics.
translation: 能否钓到鱼、钓到多少以及鱼的种类，受许多因素影响。捕鱼方式、所用装备和你的捕鱼技能当然都会影响运气。不同鱼类栖息在不同水深，有些只生活在湖里，有些则生活在河里。一天中的时段也会影响钓到某些鱼的机会。随着你使用不同装备和策略积累经验，就会逐渐了解这些规律。

original: Eat something
translation: 吃点东西

original: SHELTER IN THE WOODS
translation: 林中庇护所

original: Sometimes it's useful to build yourself a shelter if you are planning to stay in a certain region for a long time or even just want to sleep one night more comfortably - or to stay dry when it's raining. Therefore, your next task is to find a good place (you may want to wander around a bit to find a pleasant one) and make a shelter by using your building skill. After your shelter is finished you may want to sleep there a night or two.
translation: 如果你打算在某个地区待很久，或只是想睡得舒服些、下雨时保持干燥，建造庇护所会很有用。因此，你的下一个任务是找个好地方（可以四处走走，挑个舒心的位置），再用建筑技能建造庇护所。建好后，不妨在那里睡上一两晚。

original: You may want to collect some firewood or food near the shelter for later use. Generally it's useful to build your shelter near water - if you don't have some with you. It also wouldn't hurt to spend part of the evening gathering some food, fish or berries for example, for the next few days - as you now have a camp to return to when the night falls.
translation: 你可以在庇护所附近收集些柴火或食物留待以后使用。通常在水源附近建庇护所很方便，尤其是你没有随身带水的时候。傍晚也可以花些时间收集未来几天要吃的东西，比如食物、鱼或浆果；夜幕降临时，你就有营地可以返回了。

original: Movement and rest actions
translation: 移动与休息动作

original: SPELL
translation: 法术

original: You should be aware that there are supernatural spirits, guardians and dwellers in The Unreal World. Your way of communicating with and affecting the spirit world are the spells and incantations that you learn. Now review your spells and magic means profile and perform one of those, but don't select it randomly. The spells, sacrifices and incantations you perform should always be chosen to reflect your recent deeds or the present situation.
translation: 你应该知道，虚幻世界中存在超自然精灵、守护者和居住者。你可以通过学会的法术和咒语与灵界交流，并对其施加影响。现在查看你的法术和魔法手段资料，施行其中一种，但不要随意选择。你施行的法术、献祭和咒语，应当总是结合近期的行为或当前情境来选择。

original: It is adviced that you familiarize yourself with the mythology information and spell descriptions at some point. You will learn more spells during the game in addition to the ones you start the game with.
translation: 建议你找时间熟悉神话资料和法术说明。游戏过程中，你还会学到更多法术，除了开局时已经掌握的那些。

original: Spells and magic means
translation: 法术和魔法手段

original: You can find signs of wandering animals by using your tracking skill, and that is your next task. Tracks are easiest to find on the zoomed-in maps as they are shown graphically, but the skill can also be used on the zoomed out wilderness map. You will probably need to search for tracks in several places to find a trail, unless an animal is encountered face to face and a visible trail is spotted. Not all animals will leave tracks on any surface, except in the wintertime and on fresh snow. Reading the in game info about tracking is recommended, as there are many factors involved. If it seems to take a long time to locate some tracks there's no need to rush. Keep yourself fed, take a break and continue the next day.
translation: 使用追踪技能可以发现游荡动物留下的踪迹，这就是你的下一个任务。在放大的地图上，踪迹会以图形显示，因此最容易发现；不过在缩小的荒野地图上也能使用这项技能。你可能需要在几处地方搜索，才能找到一条踪迹路线；如果你正面遇到动物并发现了明显的踪迹，则另当别论。除了冬季的新雪地，并非所有动物都会在任何地面留下踪迹。建议阅读游戏内有关追踪的信息，因为影响因素很多。如果找踪迹花了很久，也不用着急。吃饱、休息一下，明天再继续。

original: If you feel like it, you can try to track down the creature whose tracks you found. Use tracking again on the most recent track locations if you can't figure out the animal's direction otherwise. If you are tracking on the wilderness scale map, an encounter will happen when you reach your prey. Although it's usually more fruitful to zoom-in to the local map if you think you are closing in on your prey or need detailed visual information about the trail.
translation: 如果你愿意，可以追踪留下那些踪迹的生物。如果无法判断动物的去向，就在最近发现踪迹的位置再次使用追踪技能。如果你在荒野地图上追踪，抵达猎物时就会遭遇它。不过，如果你觉得快要接近猎物，或需要仔细查看踪迹路线，通常切换到局部地图会更有帮助。

original: Game encyclopedia; a hypertext guide
translation: 游戏百科与超文本指南

original: THE SEARCH FOR WILDLIFE
translation: 寻找野生动物

original: Man is not the only being roaming The Unreal World; there are also wide variety of animals which you can't avoid encountering from time to time, and which you need to learn to hunt down or defend yourself against. Your task now is to wander until you encounter an animal in the wilderness. You may wander around the wilderness map and try out your tracking skill here and there. With skill, luck and patience you may be able to track down an animal, but bumping unexpectedly into wildlife while walking through the wilderness is also common. People also sometimes share news about sightings, especially of bigger animals. If your expedition takes you far away, refer to your map of known areas to find your way in the world.
translation: 在虚幻世界中漫游的不只有人类，还有各种动物。你难免会时常遇到它们，也需要学会猎杀它们或保护自己。现在的任务是在荒野中漫游，直到遇到动物。你可以在荒野地图上四处走走，并时不时试试追踪技能。凭借技巧、运气和耐心，你也许能追踪到动物；在荒野行走时意外撞见野生动物也很常见。人们有时也会分享目击消息，尤其是大型动物。如果探险走得很远，可以参考已知区域地图，辨明自己在世界中的位置。

original: You have encountered something in the wild. If the animal encountered is not in your sight from the start, you will need to move around on the zoomed in map to find it. If you can locate the animal (they may also escape from you very quickly) you can stalk it if you're hungry or run away if it's dangerous to you. Different animals behave in different ways, are active at different times of the day etc., and knowing their habits is very important. If you are an inexperienced hunter, not disturbing predators that are potentially aggressive may be wise.
translation: 你在野外遇到了某种生物。如果一开始看不到遇到的动物，就需要在放大的地图上移动寻找。如果找到它（它也可能很快逃走），饿了就可以悄悄跟踪它；如果它对你有危险，就逃跑。不同动物的行为和活动时段各不相同，了解它们的习性很重要。如果你是缺乏经验的猎人，最好别惊扰可能具有攻击性的掠食动物。

original: Map of known areas
translation: 已知区域地图

original: A KILL
translation: 猎杀

original: Now you need to hunt down and kill an animal. If the animal you have encountered is too challenging for you, back away and go track down something else, and this time make sure you are properly prepared and equipped for the encounter. Sometimes you may need to hide and sneak (stalk) so as not to alarm a dangerous or skittish animal. Sometimes a quick rush and some running after escaping prey is required. It's up to you whether you choose close combat or ranged weapons such as a bow and arrow to bring down the animal.
translation: 现在你需要猎杀一只动物。如果遇到的动物对你来说太难对付，就先撤退，再去追踪别的猎物；这次务必做好准备并带齐装备。有时你需要躲藏并潜行接近，以免惊动危险或容易受惊的动物；有时则需要迅速冲上去，并追赶逃跑的猎物。你可以选择近战，也可以用弓箭等远程武器猎杀动物。

original: Slain animals provide meat and skin. If the animal you killed was a large one, a rare species or sacred (for example a bear) it might be justified to sacrife some of the meat to the supernatural guardians. If you were injured during the fight you can take care of your wounds by using your physician skill.
translation: 猎杀动物可以获得肉和皮。如果你杀死的是大型动物、稀有物种或神圣动物（例如熊），向超自然守护者献祭一部分肉或许是合适的。如果你在搏斗中受了伤，可以用医疗技能处理伤口。

original: Attack with 1st weapon
translation: 用第一件武器攻击

original: Throw something, or shoot an arrow
translation: 投掷物品或射箭

original: You can use the skins of the animals you've hunted to make clothes or to trade away, especially if it's a valuable fur. However, the fresh skin needs to be tanned before it's useable as fur or leather, and that is your next task. First use your hideworking skill to skin the carcass. After this you may want to cut up the carcass for the meat and fat. When you have the fresh hide in your inventory, use your hideworking skill again to tan the skin; you'll need either the animal fat or some bark and some water during the process.
translation: 你可以用猎获动物的皮制作衣物，也可以拿去交易；珍贵毛皮尤其值钱。不过，新鲜兽皮必须经过鞣制才能作为毛皮或皮革使用，这就是你的下一个任务。先用皮革加工技能剥取尸体的皮。之后可以把尸体切开，取出肉和脂肪。把新鲜兽皮放进物品栏后，再次使用皮革加工技能鞣制；过程中需要动物脂肪，或树皮和水。

original: The tanned skin is called fur or leather depending on the skin type. Leather is useful for making clothes and other items. Fur is valuable even if not processed into a piece of clothing. The value of the fur depends on the animal species you got it from and the season when it was obtained. In the wintertime the animals' furs are at their thickest and are much more valuable. Skins can also be cured which preserves them until you have the time to tan them. If the fresh skin isn't cured nor tanned within a couple of days it will begin to rot and lose its value.
translation: 根据兽皮的种类，鞣制后的皮会成为毛皮或皮革。皮革适合制作衣物和其他物品。即使不做成衣物，毛皮也很值钱。毛皮价值取决于动物种类和获取季节。冬季动物的毛皮最厚，也更值钱。你还可以先把兽皮晾干保存，等有空时再鞣制。如果新鲜兽皮过了两三天，既未晾干保存也未鞣制，就会开始腐烂并失去价值。

original: Butcher -- cut a carcass for meat
translation: 屠宰尸体取肉

original: SETTING A TRAP
translation: 设置陷阱

original: Various traps are used in passive hunting to catch different animals. Your task now is to try this out and set a trap anywhere you like. You must zoom into the local terrain, set a trap either with the apply command if you have a single item trap, or by using the TRAPPING skill to make one of the various trap constructions by yourself. After the trap is set zoom back out to the wilderness map. You can freely decide the trap location and form based on what kind of animals you want to catch. If you are after carnivores, baiting the trap after it has been set is required to make it effective at all.
translation: 不同陷阱用于被动狩猎，可捕捉不同动物。现在试着设置一处陷阱，地点任你选择。你必须切换到局部地形图；如果手上是单件陷阱物品，就用“使用”命令设置，或者使用设陷阱技能自行制作各种陷阱结构。设置好后，缩回荒野地图。你可以根据想捕捉的动物，自由选择陷阱的位置和形式。如果目标是食肉动物，设置陷阱后还必须放置诱饵，陷阱才会有效。

original: Different traps are designed for different species of animals. Reading the game-info on traps is recommended. Passive hunting using traps can be an efficient way to keep yourself warm and well-fed.
translation: 不同陷阱针对不同动物。建议阅读游戏内有关陷阱的信息。用陷阱被动狩猎，是让自己保持温暖、吃饱的有效方式。

original: Apply (use) a tool or container
translation: 使用工具或容器

original: CHECKING THE TRAP
translation: 检查陷阱

original: Your next task is to check the trap you have set. You usually need to wait at least for a day before it's worthwhile to check your traps. Continue with other activities until your trap has been set for a day or two, then find its location and zoom in to check it out. You can locate your set traps from the map of known areas even if you've traveled far away from your hunting grounds.
translation: 你的下一个任务是检查已经设置的陷阱。通常至少要等一天，检查陷阱才有意义。先继续做其他事情，等陷阱放置一两天后，再找到陷阱所在的位置，再切到局部地图检查。即使你已经远离狩猎区域，也可以通过已知区域地图定位自己设置的陷阱。

original: If something has gotten caught into the trap you can deal with it as you please. If the trap hasn't been triggered and you wish to set it elsewhere disassemble it first. Then you can either pick up the single item trap or the raw materials used. If you find the trap triggered but no animal is caught in it, the animal which entered the trap may have been strong enough to free itself from the trap. To set a triggered trap again, pick up and apply a single item trap again or use reset a trap construction option.
translation: 如果陷阱捕到了东西，你可以自行处置。如果陷阱没有触发，而你想把它移到别处，先将其拆解。之后可以捡起单件陷阱，或收集用过的原材料。如果发现陷阱已触发却没有捕到动物，可能是进去的动物力气足够大，挣脱了陷阱。要重新设置已触发的陷阱，单件陷阱可以捡起后再次使用；陷阱结构则使用重置陷阱选项。

original: A SETTLEMENT
translation: 定居点

original: Even if you can survive on your own it's useful to know where you can find other people. Your next task is to find a village or settlement and enter it to see what it can offer you. There is a vast wilderness and villages are rather rare, so you may want to equip yourself carefully for this expedition. When you are ready start roaming across the wilderness map. Settlements usually tend to be near water and watercourses. Checking cultural regions from the map of known areas helps you to know when you are wandering in an inhabitated region. If you encounter some wandering people you can talk to them and ask for directions to the nearest village.
translation: 即使你能独自生存，知道哪里能找到其他人也很有用。你的下一个任务是找到一个村庄或定居点，进去看看那里有什么。荒野辽阔，村庄相当稀少，因此这趟旅程最好准备周全。准备好后，就从荒野地图出发吧。定居点通常靠近水源或水道。查看已知区域地图上的文化区域，可以了解自己是否身处有人居住的地区。如果遇到游荡的人，可以和他们交谈，询问最近村庄的方向。

original: Feel free to explore this settlement to see what the area and people around here can offer you. Settlements vary greatly depending on the culture of the people, from the small kota-villages of the North to the large bustling villages of the Driik. From the larger villages you can find stores with varying goods for trade. In the small settlements of Kaumo for example you can only trade with the people directly. All of the equipment that people carry, gather and produce - weapons, tools, food etc. are also culture-dependent.
translation: 尽管探索这个定居点，看看当地环境和居民能提供什么。不同文化的定居点差异很大，从北方的小型科塔村到德里克人的繁忙大村都有。较大的村庄里有商店，出售各种可交易的商品。例如在考莫人的小型定居点，你只能直接和居民交易。居民携带、采集和制作的所有装备——武器、工具、食物等——也都因文化而异。

original: Chat (talk) with someone
translation: 与某人交谈

original: TRADING
translation: 交易

original: You can trade for items with people you meet, and also trade for goods you may find from the villages. Your next task is to trade something with somebody. If you want to trade goods from a village first pick up the the items you are interested in and then talk to somebody when you are done. To trade with individual people just talk to them. Remember that not everyone is willing to trade with you, and they won't trade away all of their possessions.
translation: 你可以和遇到的人交易，也可以在村庄里购买或交换货物。下一个任务是和某人交易。若想交易村庄里的货物，先捡起感兴趣的物品，然后再找人交谈。和个人交易时，直接与对方交谈即可。记住，不是所有人都愿意和你交易，而且他们也不会卖掉全部家当。

original: Then there are wandering foreign traders who have expensive and rare armours and weapons they brought with them from far away. If you ever meet some foreign traders remember that they are after furs, the higher quality the better.
translation: 此外还有四处游荡的外国商人，他们从远方带来昂贵而稀有的盔甲和武器。如果你遇到外国商人，记住他们想要的是毛皮，品质越高越好。

original: WATERCOURSE
translation: 水道

original: Rafts and punts are watercrafts used for traveling on the water. Sestas and paddles are used to pole or row them ahead. Your next task is to get yourself a watercraft of some kind and a sesta or a paddle - then row across a lake. Notice that you can make a raft, a sesta and a paddle yourself. It's a good idea to find a lake before starting to make a raft. When you have obtained or made a watercraft, place it on the shore, step in and wield a sesta or a paddle to move your watercraft. If you do contruct a raft further from the shore you can use move items-command to drag it by the water.
translation: 木筏和小艇是用于水上旅行的船只，长篙和桨则用来撑或划船。你的下一个任务是弄到一艘船和一根长篙或一支桨，然后划过湖泊。注意，你可以自己制作木筏、长篙和桨。最好先找到湖泊，再开始造木筏。获得或造好船后，把它放在岸边，登船并手持长篙或桨行船。如果你在离岸较远的地方造木筏，可以用“搬运物品”命令把它拖到水边。

original: Travelling along watercourses is very convenient - keep this in mind. If you find a waterway connecting two regions important to you, you might leave a raft there for easy travel. With a sesta you can only travel on shallow water, so you'll want to make a paddle if you plan to travel on deeper water. You can also transport loads with the watercraft by dropping the items you wish to transport on it.
translation: 沿水道旅行非常方便，请记住这一点。如果你发现一条连接重要地区的水路，可以把木筏留在那里，方便以后出行。长篙只能用于浅水；如果打算在深水行船，就需要制作一支桨。你还可以用船运送货物，把想运的物品放到船上即可。

original: Move items -- haul items around with you
translation: 搬运物品：带着物品移动

original: A CATCH
translation: 捕鱼收获

original: Now you need to catch some fish, by using any fishing technique you want. If you are lacking fishing equipment you need to go find yourself some first. Spears and clubs can be used to catch pike from shallow waters but that's not too common - especially if you aren't a skilled fisherman. The islanders and the people of the Driik surely possess some fishing equipment if you wish to to take this task seriously, but even a little perch from a lake nearby will be counted as a catch. So check out, make or trade your fishing equipment, go by the water and then use your fishing skill. The map of known areas reveals the waters nearby if you have visited them already.
translation: 现在，你需要用任意捕鱼方式捕到一些鱼。如果缺少捕鱼装备，就先去找一些。鱼叉和木棒可以用来在浅水中叉捕狗鱼，不过这种情况不常见，尤其是你还不擅长捕鱼的时候。如果你想认真完成任务，岛民和德里克人肯定有捕鱼装备；不过，附近湖里哪怕只钓到一条小鲈鱼也算完成捕获。查看、制作或交易获得捕鱼装备，然后到水边使用捕鱼技能。若已去过附近水域，可以从已知区域地图上查看。

original: If you did get a big catch and do know the fisher's sacrifice for a catch-ritual, the supernatural guardians of the water may be expecting some favours in return for their generosity.
translation: 如果你收获颇丰，而且知道“渔获献祭”仪式，水域的超自然守护者或许会期待你回报它们的慷慨。

original: At some point you may want to settle down more properly and build your own house. Your next task is to get a feeling for this. Now find a place where you would like to live for some time - feel free to travel further from the populated areas or select a cultural territory where you feel at home - and start constructing a house of your own. It all starts by felling trees and carving them into logs with your timbercraft skill. When you have the required materials construct a section of wall to get started. Logs are heavy to carry, but you can easily move a pile of them by your building site using the move items-command.
translation: 将来你可能想安顿下来，建一栋自己的房子。下一个任务就是体验建造过程。找一处想住上一阵的地方——可以远离人烟，也可以挑选让你感到自在的文化区域——然后开始建造自己的房子。一切都从砍树开始，再用伐木技能把木头加工成原木。备齐材料后，先建一段墙。原木很重，但你可以用“搬运物品”命令把一堆原木搬到工地附近。

original: Building a house is a lengthy process and the proper tools play a sigficant role in the time it takes to reach your goal. The log walls will stand waiting for you to continue the building later on if you need to go on a hunting trip etc. for awhile. Take note that there are other contructions you can also build to make your settlement and surroundings look and work just the way you want.
translation: 建房是个漫长的过程，合适的工具会大大影响完工所需时间。如果你需要暂时离开去狩猎等，原木墙会留在原地，等你回来继续施工。还要留意其他建筑，它们也能让你的定居点和周边环境更符合你的需要。

original: In addition to hunting, fishing and gathering berries etc. agriculture is a source of independent livelihood which you need to try out now by planting something. You can spend some time looking for a nice place for your field and then use your agriculture skill to first prepare the soil and then plant some seeds or vegetables. Remember that the ground needs to be fertilized first by burning some wood, but you will be reminded of this when using the agriculture skill.
translation: 除了狩猎、捕鱼、采集浆果等，农业也是自给自足的来源之一。现在试着种点东西吧。你可以花些时间找块适合耕种的地方，然后使用农耕技能先整地，再播种或种下蔬菜。记住，土地需要先通过焚烧木材施肥；使用农耕技能时，游戏也会提醒你。

original: Seeds are hard to obtain, but preserving some of the harvested plants over the winter to be planted next spring will keep your field alive for years to come. It's a good idea to change the location of your field after a few years to let the ground rest and grow fertile again for the future.
translation: 种子很难获得，不过你可以留下一些收获的植物过冬，等来年春天播种，这样田地就能年复一年地耕种。几年后最好换一块田，让土地休养并重新恢复肥力。

original: A DOMESTIC ANIMAL
translation: 家养动物

original: From many villages you can trade the items you've found or made to obtain your own animals. Animals are very useful as pack animals to carry loads and some of them can be milked. Use extended commands to milk an animal. To pack the animal you have, use push items command to its direction. For unpacking your pack animal, use picking up items from a direction. Having livestock also naturally secures your source of fresh meat. Your next task is to get yourself an animal, either from a village or by leashing a tame animal you may occasionally encounter. Leash an animal by applying a rope to it. Talk to villagers for animal trading possibilities.
translation: 你可以在许多村庄用找到或制作的物品换取自己的动物。动物很有用，可以驮运货物，有些还可以挤奶。使用扩展命令给动物挤奶。要让动物驮东西，使用“推送/装载”命令把物品推向它；要从驮畜身上取下物品，使用从某方向拾取命令。饲养牲畜自然也能确保有新鲜肉食。你的下一个任务是弄到一只动物，可以从村庄获得，也可以给偶尔遇到的驯服动物套上绳子。对动物使用绳子即可拴住它。和村民交谈，了解是否能交易动物。

original: You may want to build a fence to keep your animals where you want. When the rope that is used as an animal leash is applied again the animal will be freed, but naturally can be leashed again so long as it hasn't wandered off. Traveling with a big bunch animals is not a wise maneuver for a hunter since wild animals will naturally avoid such a party. Dogs can be very valuable companions when hunting more dangerous game like bears or wolves.
translation: 你可能想建一道围栏，把动物圈在需要的地方。再次使用拴住动物的那根绳子，就能放开它；只要动物还没走远，之后也可以重新拴住它。猎人带着一大群动物旅行并不明智，因为野生动物通常会躲开这样一队人马。猎熊或猎狼等危险猎物时，狗会是非常宝贵的伙伴。

original: Pick up from adjacent tile, pack animal or companion
translation: 从相邻格子、驮畜或同伴处拾取

original: A COMPANION
translation: 同伴

original: For more safety while wandering in the wilderness you can ask some people to join you. Together it's a lot easier to face the setbacks and dangers of the world. Your next task is to get yourself a companion for a short journey. Find some people and talk to them asking them to join you by selecting the "Ask for help" chat option. Besides of hiring people only to hunt or go adventuring with you, they can help you in your daily life - for example if you need some extra hand at your building site.
translation: 在荒野中游荡时，你可以请人加入队伍，让旅途更安全。共同面对这个世界的挫折和危险会容易得多。下一个任务是找一位同伴，结伴短途旅行。找到人后与其交谈，选择“请求帮助或结伴”，邀请对方加入。除了雇人陪你狩猎或冒险，他们也能帮你处理日常事务，例如在工地搭把手。

original: Now that you have a companion feel free to carry on adventuring, hunting or whatever as you like. When you talk to your companion now, pay attention to the special command options which can be used to give little tasks and duties to your companion.
translation: 现在你有同伴了，可以继续冒险、狩猎，或做任何你喜欢的事。与同伴交谈时，留意那些特殊命令选项；你可以用它们给同伴安排一些小任务。

original: SOURCE OF LIVELIHOOD
translation: 生计来源

original: First of all you must now secure your source of livelihood and gather yourself something to eat for the next few days. Check out your inventory to see what you already carry and fill your supplies the way you want: use your fishing skill, or tracking skill to track down and hunt animals, or if it's a suitable time of the year zoom into the terrain to gather berries or mushrooms. Or trade food from the people you meet if that's what suits you best. When you think you have enough food for at least five days eat something - and if you have plenty of food, the task is completed and you are ready to move on.
translation: 首先，你现在得保障生计，为接下来几天准备食物。查看物品栏，看看已经带了什么，再按需要补充储备：使用捕鱼技能，或用追踪技能追踪并猎杀动物；如果时节合适，也可以切换到局部地形图采集浆果或蘑菇。你也可以和遇到的人交易食物。觉得至少够吃五天时，就吃点东西；如果手头食物充足，任务便会完成，你可以继续前进。

original: When one hunts down a big elk or other large animal, there's no need to worry about food for weeks. But sometimes even if you feel your supplies are sufficient some extra won't hurt - especially if there's a longer expedition planned up ahead. Then again a very skilled hunter or fisherman can wander around carrying barely more than a bow or a fishing rod and catch himself a meal when feeling hungry.
translation: 猎到一头大驼鹿或其他大型动物，几个星期都不用担心食物。但有时即使觉得储备足够，多备一些也无妨，尤其是前方还有长途旅行时。另一方面，熟练的猎人或渔夫只带一把弓或一根鱼竿四处游荡，饿了再捕猎或捕鱼，也能解决一餐。

original: NO MAN'S LAND
translation: 无人区

original: You can view cultural regions from the map of known areas. Your task now is to pick up your things and travel to any area that doesn't belong to any cultural region (appears in black color). Check out your destination first and equip yourself properly for the expedition, maybe make yourself some items or tools you might find necessary. On your journey you may need to fill in supplies, so feel free to try out your tracking and fishing skills for example. And feel free to explore villages or interact with people if they come in your way. When you've reached the no man's land, settle down and use your building skill to make a shelter.
translation: 你可以在已知区域地图上查看文化区域。现在收拾好物品，前往不属于任何文化区域的地方（地图上显示为黑色）。先查看目的地，为旅程做好准备，也许还要制作一些你认为必需的物品或工具。途中可能需要补充物资，不妨试试追踪或捕鱼技能。若沿途经过村庄或遇到居民，也可以探索或与他们互动。抵达无人区后安顿下来，用建筑技能建造一个庇护所。

original: There are differences in peoples' equipment and settlements depending on what culture they belong to. The more you visit the settlements of different cultures, the more you'll find what a certain culture can offer to you. If you walk to the very border of the known map you can choose and randomize another region to continue playing in.
translation: 不同文化的人们，其装备和定居点也各不相同。走访不同文化的定居点越多，你就越能了解各地能提供什么。如果走到已知地图的边界，可以选择并随机生成另一个区域，继续游戏。

original: A HARVEST
translation: 收获

original: The wilderness carries berries and mushrooms from early spring to late winter, and people grow crops on their fields. Your task now is to harvest some of the gifts the earth produces, either from a field of your own, or someone elses - or to pick berries or mushrooms. If the season is now winter in its darkest and coldest phase, you need to wait for spring. If it's autumn, it should be easy to find something to harvest. To harvest a plant you need to just simply pick it up. The herblore skill can be used to recognize unknown plants and identify their properties. or mushrooms in the area.
translation: 从早春到深冬，荒野中都有浆果和蘑菇；人们也会在田里种植作物。现在的任务是收获大地的馈赠：可以从自己的田地或别人的田地采收作物，也可以采摘浆果或蘑菇。如果正值最寒冷、最黑暗的冬季，就得等到春天；如果是秋季，应该很容易找到可采收的东西。要采收植物，可用拾取命令。可以使用草药学技能辨认陌生植物并了解其特性，也能辨认附近的蘑菇。

original: The type of berries or mushrooms found in the wilderness depends on the terrain type and the season. You can find mushrooms suprisingly late in the autumn, even after the first snow has come. With mushrooms some caution may be required, since some of them are very poisonous.
translation: 荒野中能找到哪种浆果或蘑菇，取决于地形和季节。秋天很晚时仍可能找到蘑菇，甚至初雪之后也有。采蘑菇时要小心，因为有些蘑菇毒性很强。

original: SAUNA
translation: 桑拿浴

original: The sauna is a place for cleaning up, but also for physical and mental relaxation, healing, and giving birth. Your task now is to find a sauna, which exist in nearly every settled village - and sometimes even in vagabond settlements. You will recognize the sauna as being a small building with a fireplace alike sauna stove, and a tub of water. Heat up the sauna for several hours by building a fire in the sauna stove. Then take off your clothes, pick up the tub of water and apply it beside the sauna stove to throw water on top of it for steam. Loading firewood into the sauna stove before making a fire is easiest by having a pile of firewood beside your feet and using push items-commands.
translation: 桑拿房可以清洁身体，也有助于放松身心、疗伤和分娩。你的下一个任务是找一间桑拿房；几乎每个定居村落都有，有时流浪者营地也有。桑拿房通常是小屋，里面有类似炉子的火炉和一桶水。先在桑拿炉里生火，烧上几个小时。然后脱掉衣服，拿起水桶，在桑拿炉旁使用这桶水，把水泼到炉上，让蒸汽升起。生火前，最好先把一堆柴火放在脚边，再用“推送/装载”命令把柴火装进桑拿炉。

original: If you are feeling ill, exhausted, or even wounded, taking a sauna bath can be a source of relief for your ailments. Taking a sauna bath can also be a spiritual experience. There are supernatural beings taking care of and living in the sauna, so enjoy your bath with a grateful attitude.
translation: 如果你觉得身体不适、筋疲力尽，甚至受了伤，洗桑拿或许能缓解不适。桑拿浴也可以成为一种精神体验。桑拿房里有超自然生灵居住并照料此处，洗浴时请怀着感恩之心。

original: Throw water on the sauna stove
translation: 向桑拿炉泼水

original: LARGE-SCALE PASSIVE HUNTING
translation: 大规模被动狩猎

original: Trap-fences are effective especially for catching big animals that move in herds, for example wild reindeers. Your task now is to build a trap-fence of your own. Find a good place, zoom into the terrain and start building the fence, and maybe read the hunting and fences section of the game-info browser for more information that can be useful. The shape of the fence is up to you, but the idea here is to make a fence that an animal will start to follow and leave an opening here and there. In the openings you need to dig pits by using a shovel. When your fence is ready, turn pits into a trap-pits and zoom back out to the wilderness map to finish the task. The fence needs to be rather long to be effective.
translation: 围栏陷阱尤其适合捕捉成群活动的大型动物，例如野生驯鹿。你的任务是自己建一道围栏陷阱。找个好地方，切换到局部地形图后开始建造围栏；也可以阅读游戏信息浏览器中有关狩猎和围栏的章节。围栏形状由你决定，但要让动物沿着围栏前行，并在适当位置留出若干开口。在各个开口处用铲子挖坑。围栏建好后，把挖出的坑改造成陷阱坑，再缩回荒野地图，即可完成任务。围栏必须够长才有效。

original: Your trap fence is now finished and you can leave it to hopefully catch something. You can also use regular traps instead of pits and also bait your traps to attract carnivores. Trap-fences are a long-term passive hunting construction. Just remember to reset the traps that got triggered during use and set fresh baits (if you are after carnivores) whenever you check your traplines.
translation: 围栏陷阱已经建好，可以留在那里，希望能捕到东西。你也可以使用普通陷阱代替陷阱坑，并放置诱饵吸引食肉动物。围栏陷阱是一种适合长期使用的被动狩猎设施。记得定期检查陷阱线时，重置已经触发的陷阱；如果目标是食肉动物，也要换上新诱饵。

original: LEARNING BY DOING
translation: 熟能生巧

original: All of the skills your character has will improve with use. The improvement is a lengthy process though, and relative to how often you use a certain skill. You'll learn fishing by fishing, and you'll learn timbercrafting by felling trees and carving logs, and so on. Weapon skills also improve by using those weapons for hunting or in combat. No special notification is given when a skill improves. Check out your skill profile and mastery levels from time to time to see if there's any improvement. Your task now is to improve one of your skills a bit. You can live your life normally and use skills in an ordinary manner and eventually this will happen. You can also extensively use a particular skill to improve it faster.
translation: 角色拥有的所有技能都会随着使用而提升。不过提升过程很漫长，速度取决于你使用某项技能的频率。捕鱼能提升捕鱼技能；砍树、加工原木能提升伐木技能，其他技能也一样。使用武器狩猎或战斗，也能提升对应的武器技能。技能提升时不会收到特别提示。时不时查看技能资料和熟练度，看看有没有进步。现在的任务是稍微提升一项技能。照常生活并正常使用技能，最终就会有所提升。你也可以集中大量使用某项技能，让它更快进步。

original: One of your skills has improved a bit! See your skill profile to check out what it was. The lower the skill level the faster it will improve. As you start to master a skill, improving it gets slower and harder.
translation: 你的一项技能有所提升！查看技能资料，看看提升的是哪项。技能等级越低，提升越快。随着你逐渐精通一项技能，提升会越来越慢、越来越难。

original: PREY IN A TRAP
translation: 陷阱中的猎物

original: As you probably now have some experience with traps, your next task is not only to successfully set or make traps but to actually have an animal visit, and hopefully get caught in your trap. Take some time to make and set traps, and then check them out regularly in the hope of finding prey in one. You can use trap-fences, traps for specific animals, or whatever you'd like. Be sure to use bait if you are after predators. When using pit-traps you also may want to try making the ones with sharp wooden stakes, which is a very lethal form of a trap-pit.
translation: 你现在大概已经有一些设置陷阱的经验。下一个任务不只是成功设置或制作陷阱，还要等到有动物来过陷阱，运气好的话还能抓住它。花些时间制作和设置陷阱，再定期检查，希望能在其中发现猎物。你可以使用围栏陷阱、针对特定动物的陷阱，或任何你喜欢的方式。若目标是掠食动物，记得放诱饵。使用陷阱坑时，也可以试试带尖木桩的陷阱坑，这种陷阱非常致命。

original: An animal has now either visited or gotten caught in your trap. Bigger animal can get rid of small traps, and smaller animals can run over trap-pits without dropping in. Go beside the trap at this area now to see what the situation is - only a trigger or an actual catch - and deal with the animal as you like. If it was a false alarm, reset the triggered trap if you want to continue using it.
translation: 现在有动物来过你的陷阱，或已经被困住。大型动物可能挣脱小陷阱；小动物则可能直接越过陷阱坑而不掉进去。现在到这个地点的陷阱旁看看情况——它只是被触发，还是确实捕到了东西——然后按你喜欢的方式处置动物。如果只是虚惊一场，而你还想继续使用这个陷阱，就重置它。

original: BURIED INTO THE BOG
translation: 埋入沼泽

original: Swamps and bogs are a strange and intimidating terrain feature. There are stories about rare occasions when both people and animals have been sacrificed and buried into peat bogs. Weapons and other items are sometimes hidden or sacrificially buried into bogs. Your task now is to sacrificially bury some sort of metal weapon. A knife, a sword or an axe. Bogs are also a source of ore which is used to make iron, and thus the very origin of the iron. Go to the swamp or bog at night, build a fire, and then throw the weapon into the waters of the open bog. This is a gesture of respect for the bog and a way to ritually bond yourself with the iron more closely.
translation: 沼泽和泥炭地地形奇异而令人敬畏。传说偶尔有人和动物被献祭后埋入泥炭沼泽。武器和其他物品有时也会藏在沼泽里，或作为祭品埋入其中。你的任务是献祭并埋下一件金属武器：小刀、剑或斧头。沼泽也是铁矿石的来源，而铁正是从这里开始的。夜晚前往湿地或泥炭沼泽，生起火，然后把武器扔进开阔沼泽的水中。这是对沼泽表达敬意的举动，也是一种通过仪式让自己与铁建立更深联系的方式。

original: When there's need for you to sacrifice meat for the supernatural guardians, coming to butcher an animal at the swamp is the way to do it with utmost dedication. Certain bog types are also a source of tasty berries in the autumn.
translation: 如果需要向超自然守护者献祭肉食，来到沼泽屠宰动物，是最虔诚的做法。某些泥炭沼泽类型在秋天也能找到美味的浆果。

original: SALT FROM THE COAST
translation: 海岸寻盐

original: Salt is rare, valuable, and very useful. Salt production generally takes place on an archipelago. Driik and the regions of the Islanders are the main areas where you can obtain salt. Salt is rarely found inland, but may be brought in by foreign traders and tradesmen of the inland. Your task is to travel to an archipelago of The Unreal World to find and trade for some bags of salt. Remember that you need to get the salt by trading, and only by trading. Be sure to bring something along that you can trade for the salt.
translation: 盐既稀有又珍贵，用途也很广。盐通常在群岛上生产。德里克人和岛民居住的地区是获取盐的主要地点。内陆很少见到盐，但外国商人和内陆商贩有时会带来盐。你的任务是前往虚幻世界中的群岛，寻找并交易几袋盐。记住，必须通过交易获得盐，不能用其他方式。记得带上可以拿来交换盐的物品。

original: If you haven't tried salting meat or fish before, now would be a good time. The hardship of obtaining salt is compensated when you can make yourself a decent supply of salted meat or fish.
translation: 如果你还没试过腌制肉或鱼，现在正是好时机。辛苦弄到盐，换来一批像样的腌肉或腌鱼，就很值得了。

original: AN ISLAND
translation: 岛屿

original: Now you need to travel over the water. Find an island and make your way to it by travelling on the wilderness map. This way you'll spot any nearby islands from a good distance away. There are some big lakes in the inland, and but an island may not be easy to find. If you are at the archipelago or near the sea, there are lots of bigger and smaller islands. In this task we're after a small, cosy island. You of course need to get or make yourself a watercraft also, and a paddle. A punt is a convenient watercraft since it can be carried with you. If you're going to make a raft, it's best to wait until you've already spotted an island to do so. Rafts are heavy, and having to move it to another lake if you don't find an island here may prove to be a difficult task.
translation: 现在你需要跨越水面。找到一座岛，并在荒野地图上航行过去。这样你就能从远处发现附近的岛屿。内陆有些大湖，但岛屿不一定容易找到。如果你在群岛或海边，大小岛屿就很多。这个任务要找的是一座舒适的小岛。当然，你还需要弄到或制作一艘船和一支桨。小艇很方便，因为可以随身携带。如果要造木筏，最好等发现岛屿后再造。木筏很重；如果在这里没找到岛屿，还得把它搬到另一个湖，那会很麻烦。

original: Now that you are on an island, and if it's not too big, it's possible to spend your time there securely and without being disturbed. Islands are also good places to hide some of your most precious goods. If you have animals, herding them onto an island will help protect them from wolves and other predators.
translation: 现在你已经到了岛上；如果岛屿不太大，就能在那里安稳度日，不受打扰。岛屿也是藏匿珍贵物品的好地方。如果你养了动物，把它们赶到岛上能保护它们免遭狼和其他掠食动物袭击。

original: ARCHERY
translation: 射箭

original: A bow can be a very efficient weapon in hunting and in combat. Your task now is to practice archery and improve your skills as a bowman. Find or make yourself a bow and practice your archery with a live target. This can take some time but eventually, and especially after skilled shots, you will improve - as with every skill you use. You may want to spend some time making arrows also since they do break sometimes. To shoot with a bow, have it wielded and use throw command to shoot an arrow. When you have some decent archery equipment, go bowhunting and don't expect to see results before days, sometimes even weeks, of shooting practice.
translation: 弓在狩猎和战斗中都是非常高效的武器。现在的任务是练习射箭，提升弓手本领。找一把弓或自己制作一把，再对活物练习射箭。这可能需要一些时间，但最终你会有所进步，尤其是成功命中之后；和使用其他技能一样，熟能生巧。你也可以花些时间制作箭，因为箭有时会损坏。要用弓射箭，先装备弓，再使用投掷命令射出箭矢。准备好像样的弓箭装备后，就去练习弓猎；别指望几天内就见效，有时需要练上数周。

original: Your archery skill has improved a bit now. Being a skilled bowman is very useful sometimes. You may want to continue experimenting with the bows to find the one that's right for you. Crossbows are the most powerful type of bow, but they are rare and used mostly among the Driikiläiset.
translation: 你的射箭技能现在有所提升。成为熟练的弓手有时非常有用。你可以继续尝试不同的弓，找到最适合自己的那把。弩是威力最大的弓类武器，但十分稀有，主要由德里克人使用。

original: THE SPIRIT WORLD
translation: 灵界

original: You already know some spells and incantations, and should use them to communicate with the spirit world, the supernatural guardians and the otherwordly creatures. There are spirits that live in and take care of the forest and water, for example. You will learn more spells from other people, usually within the quests or as quest rewards. Your task now is to live your life until you learn a spell. This requires meeting people and getting involved in quests that provide you with new magic means.
translation: 你已经掌握了一些法术和咒语，应该用它们与灵界、超自然守护者及异界生灵沟通。例如，有些精灵居住并守护着森林与水域。你会从其他人那里学到更多法术，通常是在任务过程中或作为任务奖励。你现在的任务是继续生活，直到学会一道法术。为此，你需要结识他人并参与能带来新魔法手段的任务。

original: It is never a good idea to perform a spell without truly feeling an urge to do it. And it's never a good idea to constantly ask favours from the supernatural world without giving anything in return. Use your newly gained spell wisely.
translation: 如果内心并没有真正想施法，就不要施法。不断向超自然世界索求恩惠，却不作回报，也绝不是好主意。明智地使用新学到的法术。

original: THE GREAT MAN OF THE FOREST
translation: 森林巨灵

original: Your task is to go against the greatest being of the forest - the Bear. Be prepared! You may want to get some people to help you in this task. Traps, tracking, exploring caves - use all the ways you have learned to find and to kill the great man of the forest.
translation: 你的任务是挑战森林中最强大的生灵——熊。做好准备！你可能需要找人帮忙。陷阱、追踪、探索洞穴——运用你学过的一切方法，找到并猎杀这位森林巨灵。

original: The bear has been killed. Now it's time for some rituals and sacrifices to thank the spirits. And remember to utilize the bear hide and the meat.
translation: 熊已经被猎杀。现在该举行仪式并献祭，以感谢精灵。别忘了利用熊皮和熊肉。

original: KAUMO FURS
translation: 考莫毛皮

original: Furs from the Kaumo region are of very high quality and hunters from far away places regularly go to Kaumo to hunt for beavers, squirrels, and foxes. Your task now is to travel to Kaumo to hunt for some high quality fur. When you are at Kaumo your task is to hunt for a valued fur bearing animal and use your hideworking skill to skin it. The animal can be for example a fox, a lynx, a beaver, and so on. Feel free to use any hunting technique you like. Trying to use a fox-trap could be good choice here. And remember: you need to hunt, kill and skin the animal in the Kaumo region.
translation: 考莫地区的毛皮品质极高，远方的猎人经常前往考莫猎取河狸、松鼠和狐狸。你的任务是前往考莫，猎取优质毛皮。到达考莫后，猎杀一种有价值的毛皮动物，并用皮革加工技能剥皮，例如狐狸、猞猁或河狸。狩猎方法任你选择；试试狐狸陷阱或许是个好主意。记住：必须在考莫地区猎杀动物并剥皮。

original: Feel free to continue your hunt for the fur now that you are at the esteemed hunting grounds. If you ever encounter foreign traders, carrying valuable furs with you may provide you with something to trade for metal armours and swords. Even if furs from squirrels, polecats and other small animals aren't big enough for making clothes easily, there's a reason to keep hunting them. Especially if you find yourself in an area that has lots of them.
translation: 既然你已经来到著名猎场，不妨继续追猎毛皮动物。若遇到外国商人，带上珍贵毛皮，也许能换到金属盔甲和剑。松鼠、艾鼬等小动物的皮可能不够做衣服，但继续猎取它们仍有理由，尤其是当你身处它们数量众多的地区。

original: CLOTHING
translation: 衣物

original: Your clothes wear out as time goes by so you'll need to get or make new clothes eventually. You can make some clothes by yourself and that's your next task: to make yourself some fur clothing. A hunter wearing a wolf or bear fur cloak for example is an impressive sight, but any fur and piece of clothing will do for now. To get fur you first need to find and kill a fur-bearing animal (a fox, hare, glutton, or bear for example) and then use your hideworking skill to skin the animal and to tan the skin. After the skin is tanned you can make clothing out of it. Naturally the bigger the cloth the more fur you will need, but smaller pieces of fur can be used to complete an item if you have enough of them to put together.
translation: 衣物会随着时间磨损，所以最终你需要获取或制作新衣服。你可以自己做衣物；下一个任务就是为自己制作毛皮衣物。例如，猎人披着狼皮或熊皮斗篷会十分威风，不过现在任何毛皮和衣物都可以。要获得毛皮，先找到并猎杀有毛皮的动物（例如狐狸、野兔、貂熊或熊），再用皮革加工技能剥皮并鞣制。鞣制后就能用它制作衣物。衣物越大，需要的毛皮越多；不过，只要有足够的小块毛皮拼接，也能完成一件衣物。

original: In addition to providing material for clothing, some furs are very valuable in trading. You can also make clothes out of leather, but the fur provides more protection and warmth.
translation: 除了能用来制作衣物，有些毛皮在交易时也很值钱。你也可以用皮革制作衣物，但毛皮提供的防护和保暖效果更好。

original: FOREIGN TRADERS
translation: 外国商人

original: Traders from far away countries come to the north, to The Unreal World, after furs. They are willing to trade their metal armours and weapons for these high quality furs. Foreign traders are now in this region. Your task is to find them and to trade with them. If you aren't carrying any furs with, trying to trade with them will be rather fruitless. If this is the case you must first get yourself some furs. Then wander around, or you can also try to find their tracks, until you find them and then make a succesful trade with some of them. You can also get news about foreign traders by talking to the people in the villages.
translation: 来自远方国家的商人来到北方的虚幻世界，是为了收购毛皮。他们愿意用金属盔甲和武器交换优质毛皮。外国商人现在就在这个地区。你的任务是找到他们并与之交易。如果身上没有毛皮，试着和他们交易多半不会有收获；这种情况下，你得先弄到毛皮。然后四处走走，也可以试着寻找他们的踪迹，直到找到他们并成功完成交易。你也可以和村民交谈，打听外国商人的消息。

original: Metal armour is especially hard to obtain from anywhere else but the foreign traders. Driikiläiset sometimes have metal armours, since the Driik is near the sea and most often in contact with foreigners.
translation: 除了外国商人，几乎很难从其他地方获得金属盔甲。德里克人有时也有金属盔甲，因为德里克地区靠海，他们经常与外国人往来。

original: SALMON AND TROUT
translation: 鲑鱼和鳟鱼

original: Salmon and trout are large, valuable fish that that can be caught from the rivers and especially from the rapids. Now you need to go after these desirable fish and use all of your fishing ability to catch one. To make your fishing succesful you need to go further from the river bank, so a watercraft like a punt or a raft will be necessary. A good salmon river may also require some exploring, the best ones are said to be found in the north.
translation: 鲑鱼和鳟鱼体型大、价值高，可以在河流中捕获，尤其是在急流处。现在去寻找这些珍贵鱼类，尽你所能捕到一条。要成功捕鱼，你需要远离河岸，因此必须使用小艇或木筏等船只。找到好的鲑鱼河可能还需要探索一番；据说最好的鲑鱼河在北方。

original: If it seems like you are catching a lot of salmon now you may want to keep on fishing. The young salmon migrate from the rivers to the sea in the spring and and after a few years they travel back to the rivers to reproduce - and at times like these the salmon fishing is very productive.
translation: 如果你现在钓到很多鲑鱼，不妨继续捕捞。幼鲑春天会从河流迁往海洋，几年后再返回河流繁殖；在这段时期，鲑鱼特别容易捕获。

original: WEAPONS OF THE NORTH
translation: 北方武器

original: The northern people are well known for their unique supernatural powers and sorcery. It is commonly held that they can drive supernatural powers into the weapons they make, especially knives and bows. And with no doubt northern knives and bows are strong and effective weapons, with or without the use of sorcery. Your next task is to obtain a northern bow or a northern knife. Travel to the northern reaches of the world, and find someone willing to trade you one of these items. Then, get a feeling for your new and unique piece of northern weaponry by wielding it.
translation: 北方人以独特的超自然力量和巫术闻名。人们普遍认为，他们能将超自然力量注入自己制作的武器，尤其是小刀和弓。毫无疑问，无论有没有巫术加持，北方的小刀和弓都是强力而有效的武器。你的下一个任务是弄到一把北方弓或北方小刀。前往世界北部，找到愿意与你交易的人。然后装备这件刚获得的独特北方武器，亲自感受它的特性。

original: If you master the oath of iron ritual you can drive supernatural powers into your metal weapons by yourself. To get a better feel for your new weapon you can try to use it the next time there's a need for it.
translation: 如果你掌握了“铁之誓”仪式，就能亲自将超自然力量注入金属武器。下次需要使用新武器时，不妨试试，进一步熟悉它。

original: A CAVE
translation: 洞穴

original: In the north of The Unreal World, and occasionally inland, you can find mountains. And in the mountains there are sometimes caves. Caves can provide a shelter for an adventurer during a rainy night, but they can also be a lynx or bear den. Your next task is to find a cave and explore it to see what's inside. You can ask directions from any people you meet, but boldly heading to northern regions will surely bring some mountains into view - but remember that not every mountain has a cave. Since the caves are dark, find or make some torches first. To light a torch you need to apply it to a burning campfire.
translation: 虚幻世界的北方，偶尔还有内陆地区，都能找到山脉。山中有时会出现洞穴。洞穴可以为冒险者遮风避雨，也可能是猞猁或熊的巢穴。你的下一个任务是找到一处洞穴并探索里面有什么。可以向遇到的人打听方向；勇敢地前往北方，肯定能看到一些山脉——但记住，并非每座山都有洞穴。洞穴里很黑，先找些火把或自己制作几个。要点燃火把，需要对燃烧的营火使用火把。

original: Most of the caves are empty, but sometimes you can find an animal lurking inside. You can turn a cave into a relatively secure camp or a hiding place for yourself if you don't mind the constant need of campfire or torches for a light source.
translation: 大多数洞穴都是空的，但有时会发现里面潜伏着动物。如果你不介意一直需要营火或火把照明，也可以把洞穴改造成相对安全的营地或藏身处。

original: BIG ELK
translation: 大驼鹿

original: Elk are the biggest animals in The Unreal World, and thus the most wanted prey when one is after a large amount of meat at once. Your next task is to hunt down an elk, but it must also be a big one. When you encounter an animal you can look at it to see if it's a small or a big individual - or an average one if no size is indicated in the description. But now you are after big game. After finding and bringing the animal down, cut it for meat and the task will be completed. Of course you may skin it first by using your hideworking skill. Use any hunting techniques you have mastered or find useful to find and catch your elk. You should expect to encounter several elks before finding a large one.
translation: 驼鹿是虚幻世界中体型最大的动物，因此也是想一次获得大量肉食时最理想的猎物。你的下一个任务是猎杀一头驼鹿，而且必须是大型个体。遇到动物时，可以查看它是小型还是大型；如果描述没有标明大小，则为普通个体。但这次你要找的是大型猎物。找到并猎杀它之后，把它切割取肉，任务就完成了。当然，你也可以先用皮革加工技能剥皮。使用你掌握或认为有用的任何狩猎技巧来寻找并捕获驼鹿。要找到大型个体，你可能得先遇见好几头驼鹿。

original: The amount of meat, and also the size of the skin you get from the slain animals is dependent of the animal size. In case of smaller animals the difference isn't that much, but when it comes to elks for example you may get tens of pounds more meat from a big individual than what you would get from a smaller one.
translation: 从猎物身上获得的肉量和皮张大小取决于动物体型。对小动物来说差别不大；但以驼鹿为例，大型个体可能比小型个体多提供几十磅肉。

original: A HOUSE
translation: 房屋

original: Your next task is to build yourself a house - a complete house. So don't rush! Find a territory and terrain which suits you. You want a place that you can call home for some time. You can also build yourself a hunting cottage somewhere. The shape and size of the house is up you, as is its usage. The task isn't complete until your house has all the walls up and you've started working on ceiling and floor. Be sure to equip yourself with the proper axes - like having a carving axe and broad axe for making logs and log walls properly. Move items-command is very useful when working with heavy lumber and organizing your piles of raw material like boards etc.
translation: 你的下一个任务是建造一栋完整的房子。别着急！找一片适合自己的土地和地形，挑个能住上一阵、称得上家的地方。你也可以在别处建一间狩猎小屋。房屋的形状、大小和用途都由你决定。墙体全部建好，并且已经开始建造天花板和地板后，任务才算完成。准备好合适的斧头，例如用雕刻斧和宽刃斧加工原木、建造原木墙。“搬运物品”命令在搬运沉重木料、整理木板等原材料堆时非常有用。

original: Your house is coming along nicely. If this is to be your home, you may also want to build a storehouse or a cellar nearby. Perhaps in the future you might have some animals in a fenced pen, or in a little field nearby.
translation: 你的房子建得很顺利。如果打算把这里当作家，也可以在附近建一间仓库或地窖。将来也许还能在围栏里养些动物，或在附近开垦一小块田地。

original: WARFARE
translation: 战争

original: Njerpez warriors, foreigners from the east, have been making raids in this region. Your next task is to find their camp and kill all of them. When you find the camp you can make plans for how and when to attack them. You'd better be prepared and properly armed too. Wandering Njerpez warriors are encountered from time to time, but in the wilderness the conflicts are easier to avoid. In their camp you can expect to find numerous warriors so hiding and sneaking could be a very useful tactic.
translation: 来自东方的涅尔佩兹战士正在袭击这一地区。你的下一个任务是找到他们的营地并杀死所有人。找到营地后，你可以计划何时以及如何进攻。务必做好准备并配备合适的武器。你偶尔会在外游荡时遇到涅尔佩兹战士，不过在荒野中更容易避开冲突。他们的营地里可能有许多战士，因此躲藏和潜行会是很有用的战术。

original: Remember to take care of your wounds by using your physician skill and see if the Njerpez warriors had some useful equipment.
translation: 记得使用医疗技能处理伤口，也看看涅尔佩兹战士身上有没有可用装备。

original: CHANGE OF THE SEASON
translation: 季节变化

original: There are four different times of the year. The seasons are spring, summer, autumn and the winter. Seasons have a great influence on daily life. The winters are cold and dark, and the lakes get covered with thick ice - a decent food supply collected in the autumn will help you to survive in the colder months. In the spring nature wakes up and begins a new life as vegetation starts to grow, mostly peaking in the late summer and then dying off in the late autumn. Your task now is to experience a little of this change of the seasons and survive until next month. You won't see a large seasonal change in a single month, but each and every day means the next season is just a bit closer. Spend your days as you please.
translation: 一年有四季：春、夏、秋、冬。季节对日常生活影响很大。冬天寒冷而黑暗，湖面会结上厚冰；秋天储备充足食物，有助于熬过寒冬。春天自然苏醒，万物重新生长；植被大多在夏末最为繁茂，到深秋便逐渐枯萎。现在的任务是体验一点季节变化，并活到下个月。一个月内看不出太大的季节变化，但每一天都会让下一季更近一些。你可以随心安排日子。

original: It can be of great use to follow the marks of nature while living your life in The Unreal World, especially knowing what season certain berries or mushrooms grow in, and so on. Hunting and fishing are regularly practiced throughout the year, but the shorter, frozen days of winter make these activities more difficult.
translation: 在虚幻世界生活时，观察自然迹象会很有帮助，尤其要了解某种浆果或蘑菇在什么季节生长。狩猎和捕鱼一年四季都能进行，但冬季白昼更短、天气严寒，会让这些活动变得困难。

original: PLEASE THE FOREST
translation: 取悦森林

original: Your task now is to please the spirits of the forest by some spell or a sacrifice. Notice that the spell must be performed according to a deed you have done - otherwise it may be meaningless. If you have just recently done something that you feel is worthy of a certain spell or a sacrifice, perform it now. Otherwise wait for an opportunity to please the spirits of the forest.
translation: 现在的任务是施行某种法术或献祭，以取悦森林精灵。注意，法术必须与自己的行为相应，否则可能毫无意义。如果你最近做过一件值得施行某种法术或献祭的事，现在就去做；否则就等待机会，再取悦森林精灵。

original: The forest has been pleased, and your travels will feel just a bit safer and more secure now.
translation: 你已取悦森林精灵，你接下来的旅程会稍微更安全、更安心。

translation: 课程与任务信息

translation: 待完成任务列表

translation: 当前任务：

translation: 相关快捷键

translation: 在游戏过程中显示此界面

original: There are several ways to accomplish each task. Sometimes you need to find a proper place or get specific equipment before it's even possible to accomplish the task. Therefore you should be aware of the possibilities the game has got to offer. Use your creativity and find alternative ways to get the tasks done. Sometimes it may take some time before circumstances are correct for the task to be done. Some extra work and patience will be also needed regularly. But as you advance - you will be rewarded...
translation: 每项任务都有多种完成方式。有时你得先找到合适地点或获得特定装备，才能着手完成任务。因此，你应该了解游戏提供的各种可能性。发挥创造力，寻找不同方法完成任务。有时要等到条件合适才能行动，也常常需要多做准备并保持耐心。但随着你不断前进，终会有所收获……

translation: 关闭此页，继续游戏

translation: 恭喜！你已成功完成这项任务。

translation: 现在尽情自由探索吧；想接下一个任务时，再打开课程信息界面。

translation: 你已经完成两套游戏课程。现在可以在《虚幻世界》中自由游玩。
